title: A green tandem cyclization approach to substituted 2-aminothiazoles via molecular sieve/I2 catalysis: DFT, molecular dockings, and pharmacokinetic profiles
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,15640-15661
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09930G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Goncagül Serdaroğlu, Nesimi Uludag, Elvan Üstün
A facile, sustainable, eco-friendly, and highly efficient procedure for the synthesis of 2-amino-1,3-thiazole derivatives was developed. The DFT simulations, molecular docking, pharmacokinetics, and drug-likeness profiles were considered.
